articles.title: Freeze the Clock Before You Refactor: Characterization Tests for Impure Code
articles.excerpt: Legacy code is rarely untestable. It is usually just unseeded. A characterization test that reads the wall clock will flake on day two. So freeze the inputs first, then pin the outputs. This is the or…
articles.body: Legacy code is rarely untestable. It is usually just unseeded. A characterization test that reads the wall clock will flake on day two. So freeze the inputs first, then pin the outputs. This is the order that survives review. Below is a reproducible loop: inventory impurity, insert one text-only boundary, record behavior, freeze it, prove the test can fail, then make the smallest safe change. The rule A characterization test freezes behavior you have , not behavior you want . That makes it a poor fit for anything nondeterministic. Seeding is not a testing nicety here. It is the precondition for having a baseline at all. Two impurity classes need different handling. Process-local impurity (clock, RNG, UUIDs, env vars) is patchable in-process.
articles.author: Dakota Huang

articles.body: SteamVR améliore la qualité d'image en streaming — et la VR scientifique dans tout ça ? Mais elle touche un paramètre qui décide si la VR peut servir à autre chose. Pourquoi la qualité d'image est un prérequis, pas un bonus En visualisation moléculaire, la charge utile visuelle est petite et dense : hélices alpha, feuillets bêta, chaînes latérales, poches de liaison. Une structure PDB typique contient des milliers d'atomes.

articles.title: Beyond Binary: A Layered Clinical Decision Support Architecture
articles.excerpt: Beyond Binary: A Layered Clinical Decision Support Architecture Abstract Diagnostic errors and missed findings remain a leading source of preventable harm in hospitals, yet most AI clinical decision s…
articles.body: Beyond Binary: A Layered Clinical Decision Support Architecture Abstract Diagnostic errors and missed findings remain a leading source of preventable harm in hospitals, yet most AI clinical decision support tools deliver binary outputs without quantifying uncertainty, without adapting to how a patient changes over time, and without helping clinicians navigate combinatorial treatment choices. This article proposes and evaluates a three-layer CDSS architecture: Layer 1 applies Bayesian decision theory for static diagnostic reasoning under uncertainty; Layer 2 uses Google's TimesFM foundation model for zero-shot multivariate time-series forecasting of patient deterioration; Layer 3 employs QAOA quantum optimization for bounded combinatorial advantage in treatment selection.

articles.body: VR 극장이 좋아질수록, 남는 질문 하나 업로드VR(UploadVR)은 Quest의 Horizon OS 2.10 PTC 업데이트가 배포 중이며, 미디어 시청을 위한 새로운 '극장 환경(Theater environment)'과 정리된 내비게이터 런처 재설계가 포함된다고 보도했습니다. 요점은 단순합니다. VR 헤드셋이 이제 '콘텐츠를 오래, 편하게 보는 기기'로 확실히 자리 잡고 있다는 것. 그런데 시청 시간이 길어질수록, 한 가지 질문이 남습니다. 그 시간은 그냥 소비인가, 아니면 훈련이 될 수도 있는가? 왜 이 문제를 시스템 관점에서 보게 되는가 개발자 입장에서 이 뉴스가 흥미로운 이유는 '환경'이 하나의 플랫폼 계층으로 다뤄진다는 점입니다. 극장 환경, 런처 재설계, 미디어 재생 파이프라인 — 이건 결국 렌더링 스택과 입력 계층 위에 얹히는 애플리케이션 레이어의 문제입니다. Horizon OS가 '오래 보는 것'을 1급 시민으로 만든다면, 그 위에 얹히는 앱은 무엇을 할 수 있을까요? Meta Quest의 하드웨어에는 흔히 간과되는 아키텍처적 특성이 하나 있습니다. 두 개의 독립적인 아이피스(eyepiece) , 즉 좌안과 우안에 서로 다른 프레임을 전달할 수 있는 스테레오 디스플레이입니다. 대부분의 미디어 앱은 이걸 단지 입체감을 위해 씁니다. 하지만 이 채널을 '같은 영상의 두 가지 다른 처리 결과'를 보내는 통로로 쓰면 어떨까요? 그 발상을 제품으로 만든 것이 Amblyotube 입니다.

The update follows a late-October New York Times report , which stated the CEO had been unfaithful to his wife with an individual that U.S. intelligence believed to be involved in a Chinese spy plot. The individual named in the report as having a relationship with Huang was Megaspeed executive and Chinese businesswoman Alice Huang or Huang Le. articles.title: On this day in space! Nov. 8, 2005: Europe launches Venus Express, its first mission to Venus
articles.excerpt: On Nov. 8, 2005, Europe launched its first mission to Venus. Here's why Venus Express mattered.
articles.body: On Nov. 8, 2005, Europe launched its first mission to Venus. The spacecraft was called Venus Express. Venus is a hothouse planet, one where the atmospheric pressure can easily crush an unprotected spacecraft. Even from orbit, Venus Express had to survive harsh radiation. But the spacecraft lasted for more than nine years. During that time, Venus Express saw a weird vortex swirling around Venus's south pole . It also saw possible signs of active volcanoes . Venus Express also discovered that the planet generates its own auroras . These auroras happen when particles from the sun hit charged particles in the atmosphere. Late in the Venus Express mission, controllers told the spacecraft to dip down into Venus's clouds — even though the spacecraft wasn't designed to do this.
articles.author: Hanneke Weitering

articles.title: Who is King Ghidorah? The cosmic connections of Godzilla Minus Zero's foe
articles.excerpt: Godzilla will go toe-to-toe with long-time foe King Ghidorah in Godzilla Minus Zero. This three-headed Kaiju's origins aren't just space-based; one of the largest structures in the universe shares its…
articles.body: Godzilla goes toe-to-toe with long-time foe King Ghidorah in Godzilla Minus Zero, which opened in theaters on Friday (Nov. 6). Though the three-headed golden Kaiju might seem like a natural native of Monster Island, King Ghidorah actually emerged from the depths of space. However, it isn't just the origins of King Ghidorah — also known as Monster Zero in the Godzilla movie Invasion of Astro-Monster (1965) — that are this beast's only cosmic connection. One of the largest structures in the universe, the King Ghidorah Supercluster , was named in honor of Godzilla's primary antagonist. Eat that, King Kong!
articles.author: Robert Lea

articles.title: Scientists simulate an Earth without life to help hunt for aliens and inhabited worlds
articles.excerpt: By modeling how a planet without life develops its atmosphere, astronomers hope to be able to better distinguish rocky planets without life from those that are inhabited.
articles.body: A new computer simulation that depicts Earth, or a rocky planet in general, without life is the latest tool in the quest to discover whether or not we are alone in the universe. Life leaves its mark on a planet, particularly its atmosphere, in the form of a mixture of biochemically created gases. Some are obvious, while others can be produced by both biology and geology, meaning that distinguishing a planet that has life from one that does not, solely based on what gases we can detect in its atmosphere, can be difficult. The key is in knowing which atmospheric conditions can be explained without life.
articles.author: Keith Cooper
